script: Inter Miami's new home was built in a rush. Ground broke in August 2023. The electricians say they had about fourteen months for their part. Around four hundred thousand work hours. More than two hundred forty electricians. An open roof, with catwalks that had nothing to mount to. Sun, rain, and a deadline. On April fourth, it opened. Twenty-six thousand seven hundred seats. And Messi scored Inter Miami's first goal there. And on November twenty-first, the playoffs come to it. Inter Miami against Columbus, game one. Have you been yet?
caption:
Inter Miami's new home was built in a rush. 🏟️

• Ground broke in August 2023.
• The electrical crew says they had about 14 months and roughly 400,000 work hours for their part, with more than 240 electricians on site.
• Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park opened on April 4, 2026: 26,700 seats, and Messi scored Inter Miami's first goal there.
• Next: playoff Game 1 vs Columbus Crew, Saturday, Nov 21, 6 PM ET.

Have you been yet? Tell us in the comments 👇 Follow @wearecancha for Miami soccer.

Video: ElectricTV, "Inside Miami's New Landmark: How IBEW 349 Is Powering Freedom Park" on YouTube. Crew figures are as stated in that video. Opening date, capacity and first goal: Nu Stadium, Wikipedia. Playoff schedule: MLS.
